# testlink

Reports the current link and connection status.

```ttl
testlink
```

## Remarks

The system variable "result" is set to one of the following values depending on the link and connection status:

<table>
 <tr>
  <th>Value</th>
  <th>Status</th>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>0</td>
  <td>Link to Tera Term has not been made.</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>1</td>
  <td>Connection to the host has not been made, but link to Tera Term has been made.</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <td>2</td>
  <td>Both connection and link have been made.</td>
 </tr>
</table>

## Example

```ttl
; If MACRO is not linked to Tera Term,
testlink
; execute the connect command.
if result=0 connect 'host'
```
